IT Coordinator Europe, Wilhelmsen Ships Service GmbH

Do you want to work for the most ambitious company in the international maritime industry challenging the status quo and help to drive the maritime industry and beyond?

Founded in Norway in 1861, Wilhelmsen is now a comprehensive global maritime group providing over half of the merchant fleet with essential products and services, along with supplying crew and technical management to the largest and most complex vessels ever to sail. Committed to shaping the maritime industry, we also seek to explore and develop new opportunities within the renewables, offshore and energy industries. Supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace, with thousands of colleagues in more than 70 countries, we take competence, sustainability, innovation, and unparalleled customer experiences one step further.

The position:

We are looking for an IT Coordinator who will be joining our Global Business Services division.

Global Business Services provides high quality, scalable and cost-efficient business support services, such as finance, HR and IT, to companies in the Wilhelmsen group.

What you will be doing:

We believe in proactive IT Support and want to empower our users with good knowledge of the tools they need to use to perform their job. In addition to the Microsoft 365 applications, we utilize the functionalities in ServiceNow to automate as much as possible, leaving our team to focus on user interaction, along with technical issues that may require physical attention.

We also have high focus on providing great service, so monitoring user satisfaction and identifying improvement potential is an integral part of this role. We have a 1st Line support team, that also needs guidance on how to support our users in the best way.

Next to 2nd line IT tasks this role will also coordinate local activities and projects related to implementation of new business applications, infrastructure changes as well as management of local IT vendors.

About the department:

The IT Coordinators are part of the User Experience team. Divided in an IT Coordinators West and East Team, providing our 2nd line and proactive services towards our internal and external customers.

In this role you become member of our User Experience West team, which is part of a global team, having colleagues not just in Europe but all over the world!

Who you are:

Are you highly motivated by helping people improve their IT knowledge on the latest Microsoft 365 tools?

Would you like to work in an international environment, where English is the corporate language, utilizing the very latest Modern Workplace technology and applications?

If so, you could be part of our team!

Classified as Internal - This content is proprietary information intended for employees and partners only.

Required experience and skills:

•Excellent written and spoken English and German skills as well as the ability to understand & convey complex IT Scenarios

•A service minded attitude and the ability to communicate with all levels within the business

•A high-level degree in IT or Business Administration or relevant industry experience.

•A driver license

What we offer:

•A fulltime (38,5 hours) as well as permanent contract

•Flexibility in working location

•An attractive salary package

•A laptop and mobile phone

•We offer bike-leasing

•You enjoy 30 annual vacation days

•An open, Scandinavian-influenced culture

Applying:

If you think you have what it takes to excel in this role, please apply online through our career portal by creating a ‘Candidate Home’ account. Here you can upload your resume in English, your salary expectations and your motivational letter including your earliest start date.

www.wilhelmsen.com/careers/

Work location: Hamburg City

Contact details: Maraike Oelkers, HR Manager Germany

jobs.description:
Digital. Inspiring. Unique.

Tchibo is one of the ten largest eCommerce companies in Germany. We could never have attained this standing without the courage to constantly rethink the old ways. In the digital world at Tchibo, we work with the latest technologies to develop sustainable and effective solutions. Do you want to help us do this? Enrich our team with your fresh ideas!

Join us as a IT Tech Lead - B2B CRM Solutions (m/f/d) in one of our dynamic, cross-functional teams that are organized around our business processes. You'll be the owner of SAP backend processes for the developing Tchibo business online shop.

In this role, you'll be technically responsible for the completion and going live of the MVP implementation within the current architecture using SAP OMF, SAP CRM (on premise) and SAP S4/HANA Retail (on premise) as the central systems. Afterwards, you'll transition the technical processes into a future-proof architecture. You'll act as a sparring partner for the business, prioritizing business requirements and technical adjustments.

Your tasks: You make the difference with us.

Responsabilities:

- Working closely  with the tech team, which is responsible for the  customer, marketing, loyalty, and B2B CRM  processes across the company
- Taking responsibility for B2B sales processes  in the tech area with the launch of a  new Tchibo business online shop  for coffee machines, coffee, and non-food products, integrating SAP Order Management Foundation, SAP Subscription Billing, SAP CRM, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP Emarsys
- Driving  the transformation of B2B sales processes  into a future-ready and modern IT landscape  based on our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and SAP systems/SAP Cloud Services and other cloud solutions
- Coordination and consultation  in our tech area closely with the business the B2B sales processes
- Driving Agentic AI Cases  for the B2B sales business – previous experience is a plus
- Troubleshooting and coordination  of resolving system issues

Your profile: You keep reinventing us.

Requirements:

- You have a successful  university degree focused on IT  or an equivalent qualification.
- You have at least 7 years of project experience in the IT field  , particularly with service-oriented architecture and SAP technologies, including experience with one or more of the following solutions and services: SAP S/4HANA, SAP Emarsys, SAP CRM, SAP Order Management Foundation (OMF), SAP Subscription Billing, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
- You bring an open mindset and a  strong interest in AI
- You  possess a strong understanding of customer relationship management and customer experience,  which is essential for bringing in your own ideas, shaping discussions, and driving the topics forward.
- Your strengths include  conceptual and analytical skills  combined with a  structured working style  that allows you to approach cross-functional issues with clarity and efficiency
- You are eager to  demonstrate responsibility and ownership  in your work, while maintaining a  hands-on mentality  that drives projects forward
- Your  strengths are in stakeholder management  and building trusted relationships across the business and tech area
- Fluency in English  (written and spoken)

Your benefits: Together we stay different.

- Work-Life Balance  : Flexible, hybrid working policy with 26 vacation days + your birthday off.
- Benefits  : Monthly transport allowance (80 RON/month), meal tickets, and health/life insurance.
- Personal Perks  : Free Tchibo coffee for home, and the chance to work on cutting-edge technology in a dynamic environment.
- Innovative Work Environment  : We are a forward-thinking team where creativity and innovation are encouraged. You will collaborate with talented professionals and contribute to building Tchibo Tech, shaping the future of our technology landscape.
- Inclusive Culture  : A diverse and inclusive workplace where your unique perspectives and ideas are valued, fostering a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.
- Impactful Work  : Our meaningful projects make a real difference, driving positive change and contributing to the success of Tchibo.

Ready to join us?

If you’re ready to take on this exciting challenge, apply now! It's super fast: register, upload attachments - done.

Let’s have a chat: recruiting.tech@tchibo.ro.

Testia GmbH is a leading company in the Aerospace Sector and part of the global Airbus Group. With over 30 years of experience, we rely on specialized inspection and testing methods as well as innovative solutions to ensure the highest standards in Quality Assurance and Maintenance. Through our international network, we are a key partner for the entire industry.

Testia Hamburg is a central hub for our aerospace services. We directly support key clients like Airbus and collaborate closely with regional small and medium-sized enterprises. Our location is not only strategically important but a hub where highly skilled teams actively shape the future of aviation.

The main activities at the Hamburg site include:

- Inspection and testing methods: Developing and applying state-of-the-art quality assurance techniques.
- Knowledge transfer: Providing expertise in non-destructive testing (NDT) and other innovative technologies through our in-house academy.

Hamburg is not only strategically important due to its proximity to Airbus but also serves as a hub where highly skilled teams work together to actively shape the future of aerospace.

As an NDT Specialist (Non-Destructive Testing), you ensure the safety and integrity of critical components, making you an essential guarantor for flight safety.

Your Tasks and Goals

- Execution of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) according to the highest aviation standards.
- Focus on Level 2 Testing in the following, critical procedures for us: Ultrasonic Testing (UT) per EN 4179 / NAS410, Eddy Current Testing (ET) per EN 4179 / NAS410, X-ray Testing (RT) per EN 4179 / NAS410
- Meticulous documentation and evaluation of measurement results for the preparation of substantiated test reports.

Your Expertise

- Completed qualification as a Materials Tester in NDT according to EN4179/NAS410.
- Proof of a Level 2 Certification in the procedures Ultrasonic, Eddy Current, or X-ray Testing. At least one procedure is mandatory.
- Proof of the required experience periods per procedure as mandated by EN 4179.
- Advanced German knowledge and Intermediate English knowledge.
- Systematic, meticulous, and independent way of working.
- Strong teamwork, resilience, and flexibility.
- Willingness to work in shifts.

Our Benefits

- Professional development in an international and growing company providing strong career opportunities
- International environment with employees from over 20+ countries
- Salary: Competitive, and based on experience.
- Extensive employee benefits within the Testia Group:
- Company Pension Scheme
- Employee Discounts
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- International Mobility
- And more from the Airbus Group

If you're passionate about contributing to the future of aerospace and are ready to take on exciting challenges, we look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team at Testia GmbH.

Since 2008, Flexoptix has been successfully developing and marketing solutions for network transceivers under the motto "Less Bullshit more Engineering". Known for our innovation with many industry-first solutions, Flexoptix continually invests in research and development to stay ahead of industry trends. At Flexoptix, we don't just provide solutions—we engineer success.Our Flexoptix team is international and welcoming with around 100 colleagues from over 15 countries, we cherish and foster different viewpoints and experiences each person brings.

Your Role

Data and AI are reshaping the way global organizations operate, and this role sits at the heart of that transformation. As a Software Engineer within our Enabling Functions Data Office, you will design and deliver high-impact data and AI solutions that power smarter ways of working across the organization. You will be part of a collaborative, internationally distributed team of engineers and architects, working within a Product-Oriented Delivery model to bring Analytics, AI, and data products to life at scale.

In this role, you will:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, data pipelines, and platform components that translate complex business requirements from enabling functions such as HR, procurement, and legal into future-ready technical solutions.
- Develop robust applications and interfaces that replace manual processes with seamless, intuitive user experiences.
- Take ownership of data platforms, ensuring cost efficiency, governance, security, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.
- Partner closely with stakeholders across your delivery pod to understand business needs and shape the technical direction of solutions.
- Shape the future of data engineering within Enabling Functions, leveraging platforms such as Snowflake, AWS, and Palantir Foundry.
- Contribute to a growing Spain-based hub within a global team, with the opportunity to work on diverse and high-visibility AI use cases spanning automation, carbon footprint analytics, procurement intelligence, and more.
